name: What happens if a project does not pass an inspection on the first visit?

mainEntity.name: What happens if a project does not pass an inspection on the first visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: If a building inspector identifies an issue, they issue a correction notice detailing the exact code requirement that must be adjusted. Because Abraham Becerra is on site leading carpentry and coordinating licensed electrical and plumbing subcontractors, our team reviews the inspector notes right away, completes the required adjustments, and schedules a reinspection. Work does not proceed to the drywall or finish stage until the rough-in correction has been inspected and approved.
acceptedAnswer.description: The inspector issues a correction notice. Our team makes the necessary adjustments promptly and schedules a reinspection before moving forward with finishing work.
